description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate and skilled leader ready to make a significant impact on our community.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and compliance with all regulatory standards. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and qualifications. We are looking for an individual who is passionate about geriatric care and committed to excellence.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Prior supervisory or leadership experience in a healthcare setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
